text:
Anna L: Quick UX check — export button in trace panel reads 'Export'. Propose 'Export traces' + format selector in modal (JSON/CSV). Thoughts? Devin R: +1 to explicit label. Also set initial focus to format selector when modal opens (current focus lands on close button). Micah P: Make 'Copy' on stack traces copy plain text (support pastes into tickets). Currently it copies HTML. Liz C: Use 'Trace ID' label instead of 'Correlation ID' — users search for trace id. Tooltip: 'Unique identifier for this request/trace'. a11y-bot: Modal must trap focus, return focus to trigger after close, aria-live="polite" on success toast, dropdown with aria-label and arrow-key nav, tooltip via aria-describedby. Devin R: Example toast:
Export complete — 42 traces. Download
Anna L: Toolbar placement? Support uses Export a lot — prefer visible toolbar item next to Share with small chevron and a tiny pill showing last-used format. Micah P: If pill shown, ensure contrast and focus ring; server should set content-disposition for downloads. I'll sanitize copied stacks (strip zero-width chars). Anna L: Owners: Anna — update Figma & copy; Devin — modal focus & aria-live; Micah — headers & sanitize; Liz — final copy review; a11y-bot — verify ARIA. Target: EOD Wed. Liz C: Short note in spec: prefer 'Trace ID' not 'Correlation ID'. Anna L: Thanks all — will create tasks and link PRs when opened.
